Cultivating a Consultant Mindset in Developers

Every developer can change the course of the projects they touch. The consultant mindset (a habit of measured, creative, and critical thinking) reaches beyond any single project and can strengthen an entire organization.

This is the cornerstone article of Sparkbox's Consultant Mindset series for developers. In it, I describe how developers can adopt this mindset and act as internal consultants who shape their organization's technical direction.
How can developers act as their own consultants and shape the technical strategy of their organization? It's easier than you think.
